_doc: Committed regression floors for the Phase 5 CI gate (eval/regression_gate.py). The gate reads the named report + the deterministic grounding stress test and fails the build (exit 1) if any metric crosses its threshold. Thresholds are set with headroom below the measured value so ordinary run-to-run noise does not flap the build, but a real regression (weakened grounding, lost significance, abstain-on-everything) trips it. Update deliberately, with the report that justifies the change, never to make a red build pass. Anchored to Phase 8 DeepInfra SIGIR (180/180 trials) after Phase 4's rate-limited truncation (60/180) stopped being the current quality floor.
